options.text: A pure compound with a fixed chemical formula
A mixture designed for a specific purpose with components in measured proportions
A chemical reaction between two elements
Any substance that has been heated

questions.explanation: A formulation is a mixture that has been carefully designed to have specific properties or uses, with components in specific proportions. Examples include pharmaceutical drugs, paints, cleaning products, and fuels.

questions.stem: A sample of aspirin melts over a range of 128-132 degrees Celsius instead of at its expected melting point of 136 degrees Celsius. What does this indicate?

options.text: The aspirin is pure but a different form

questions.explanation: The melting point is lower than expected and occurs over a range rather than at a sharp fixed point. Both of these observations indicate the presence of impurities. A pure sample of aspirin would melt at exactly 136 degrees Celsius.
